description: A support team needs to know which member benefits belong to which tier, campaign, grandfathered rule, or legacy promise for current subscribers. All programs and companies are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 31-year-old membership operations specialist handling a program with several legacy cohorts
user_profile.context: Support replies are becoming inconsistent because current entitlement depends on more than just today's published tier chart
user_profile.communication_style: Rule-aware and exact, wants entitlements tied to enrollment context rather than generic tier labels

fact_sheet.fact: The 'Spark' membership tier, priced at $19/month, includes access to the AuraVerse Digital Library and bi-weekly newsletters.
The 'Glow' membership tier, priced at $49/month, includes all 'Spark' benefits plus one Monthly Wellness Box.
The 'Radiant' membership tier was introduced on January 15, 2023, at a price of $99/month, and includes all 'Glow' benefits plus a Quarterly Strategy Call with an AuraLife coach.
The Monthly Wellness Box for 'Glow' tier members ships on the 5th of every month and contains 4-6 curated wellness products.
Quarterly Strategy Calls for 'Radiant' members are 45 minutes long and must be booked via the Calendly link in the member portal.
The 'Founders Circle' was a one-time-fee program that closed to new members on December 31, 2019.
All 150 members of the 'Founders Circle' receive one complimentary Annual Retreat Pass for life, valued at $1,200.
The 'Pioneer Program' was an early subscription model running from 2020 to 2021, which granted members a permanent 20% discount on merchandise.
Members who subscribed to any tier before July 1, 2022, are locked into their original subscription price as long as their membership remains active.
Subscribers who were on the 'Glow' tier before the 'Radiant' tier was introduced (pre-Jan 15, 2023) were granted 'Glow+' status, which includes priority email support.
Any member who joined before 2021 has their data stored in the legacy CRM 'MemberBase', not the current 'MemberHub' system.
The 'Summer Surge 2022' campaign (June 1 - Aug 31, 2022) offered new 'Glow' subscribers three free 'Friend Passes' for the AuraVerse Digital Library.
The 'Innovator2021' campaign offered the first 500 subscribers a lifetime 15% discount on all add-on purchases, including special workshops.
Members who joined using the partner code 'ZENITHCORP' receive a co-branded digital welcome kit, accessible via a unique link sent to their registration email.
The definitive source for a member's specific entitlements is the 'BenefitMatrix' internal tool, accessible at https://internal.auralife.co/matrix.
All member support tickets are managed in Zendesk, instance 'auralife1138'.
Member subscription and billing history is managed through Stripe; the customer ID can be found in the 'MemberHub' profile under 'Billing Info'.
To verify a 'Founders Circle' member's status, check for the 'FC-LIFE' tag in their MemberHub profile.
Any request to change a grandfathered pricing plan must be escalated to a Tier 2 support specialist via the 'Escalate-Pricing' macro in Zendesk.
Questions about entitlement discrepancies should be posted in the Slack channel #entitlement-qna with the member's anonymous ID.
Javier Rios is the Senior Entitlement Analyst and the final authority on legacy benefit interpretation; he can be reached at j.rios@auralife.co.
Priya Sharma is the Head of Member Success and must approve any refunds exceeding $200.
The AuraVerse Digital Library contains over 500 guided meditations and 80+ wellness courses.
The 'Spark' tier does not include access to the priority support queue; average response time is 24-48 hours.
The 'Glow+' status is automatically revoked if a member downgrades their plan or their subscription lapses for more than 14 days.
The 'Pioneer Program' 20% merchandise discount is applied automatically at checkout when the member is logged into their account; no coupon code is needed.
The 'Friend Passes' from the 'Summer Surge 2022' campaign expired on December 31, 2022, and are no longer valid.
The BenefitMatrix tool syncs with the production database every 15 minutes, starting at the top of the hour.
The Annual Retreat Pass for 'Founders Circle' members covers event admission only; travel and accommodation are not included.
A member's original sign-up campaign code, if any, is logged as a permanent custom field named 'origin_campaign' in their MemberHub profile.
